name: wikimedia-infobox-checker-finder
title: Infobox Finder
subtitle: Unused Commons photos that could replace a Wikipedia infobox photo
description: Takes a Commons category and lists the photos in it that depict a person (P180) but are not used as that person's infobox photo, side by side with the photo the article uses now, its age and resolution. Can check the person's articles on the 20 largest Wikipedias, and sort people by how many readers their article has. Runs in the browser; reads only, never edits.
keywords: commons, infobox, photos, portraits, wikiportraits, depicts

name: wikimedia-infobox-checker-gaps
title: Photo Gaps
subtitle: Living people on Wikipedia with a missing, low-resolution or old photo
description: Walks an English Wikipedia category of living people and lists everyone whose article has no infobox photo, or one that is low-resolution or old, with any Commons photos that depict them. Given one article instead, lists every Commons photo of that person, newest first. Can sort by readers. Runs in the browser; reads only.
keywords: photos, living people, missing images, commons, depicts

name: wikimedia-infobox-checker-history
title: Infobox History
subtitle: Every photo a Wikipedia article's infobox has used, and when it changed
description: For an article, a Commons file or a whole Commons category, shows the sequence of infobox photos each person's article has used, who added each and when, and whether the current one is still the newest good photo. Large categories are kept up to date by a scheduled job. Runs in the browser; reads only.

name: wikimedia-infobox-checker-score
title: Trial photo score
subtitle: Scores every Commons photo of a person for use as a generic or an infobox photo
description: Lists every Commons photo that depicts a person and scores each one in the browser with on-device face and pose detection (MediaPipe): face size, head angle, eyes, framing, resolution and age, with the rules shown on the page. Nothing is uploaded; no face is identified or matched against anything. A trial.
keywords: photos, quality, portraits, face detection, infobox

name: wikimedia-infobox-checker-headshots
title: Headshots
subtitle: Files an event's headshots under the right names, offline
description: An installable web app for event photographers: reads a folder of photos, finds the badge frames, separates people by face, can take names from a programme PDF, and renames each person's photos into a done folder, with a report linking their Wikipedia articles. Everything runs on the device in Chrome; nothing is uploaded.
keywords: event photography, headshots, wikiportraits, offline, pwa
